name: Invoice
description: A payable invoice: what is owed, when it is due, and a single way to pay it.

origin.note: Line-item table structure follows the Postmark invoice template (MIT, Wildbit).

subject: Invoice {{ invoice.number }} from {{ company.name }}

body.default: Here is your invoice. You can pay it online, or download a PDF copy for your records.

invoice.number.description: Invoice number. Keep it account-level sequential for EU and UK VAT compliance.

invoice.date.description: Issue date, absolute rather than relative.

invoice.total.description: Formatted total. Format with NumberFormatter at the call site -- decimal places are not universal.

line_items.description: Two columns only. Quantity and unit price belong as a second line inside the description cell, because two columns survive 320px with no media query.

totals.description: Subtotal, tax and total, in their own table below a divider.

pay_url.description: Hosted payment page. Never bake a permanent link -- hosted invoice URLs expire.

manage_subscription_url.description: Near one-click cancellation link. Required by Stripe for FTC and California compliance on billing mail.

footer_legal.description: Tax and legal footer. Varies by jurisdiction, so it is a token rather than baked-in prose -- and the email is never the legal document, the PDF or hosted invoice is.
